screen: Production Recreate creation flow, brief step (desktop 1440, full page), stage 4 pass 1

expected_differences: The Lab shows Content review, not this previously undrawn creation flow. Selecting Create and showing Step 2 of 7 with campaign-brief fields are correct workflow differences.
Demo Coffee Co. and its D initial correctly replace the Lab's Loopday Coffee identity.
The uploaded portrait image is the actual reference. Its intact 9:16 presentation and literal Uploaded image label are appropriate even though the requested output is a Reel.
The campaign name, creator instructions, requirements and 15–25-second duration belong to this real draft, not the Lab's fictional delivered files.
No payment, approval or publication-credit region is required on the brief step. The Lab's review actions and file statuses should not be imported here.
keep: The mineral #F4F3EF canvas, graphite #101820 navigation, restrained reversed mark and 32px desktop content gutter.
The strong application title and section heading, readable operational copy, white inputs and 8px control corners.
The uncropped portrait reference with restrained media corners, no decorative underlay and no card shadows.
The left reference and decision ledger paired with a single coherent brief task on the right.
Your campaign brief and Draft it for me: assistance is presented as editable campaign content, not an analysis result.
The visible name, instructions, removable requirements, custom requirement entry, duration fields, Continue and Back controls.
review.readiness_note: Hold desktop sign-off for the joint, reference-inspection affordance and small control targets. The core workflow remains exposed; draft generation, edit persistence, validation and navigation still require interaction testing.

drift.change: Set the desktop source/brief grid column-gap to 24px instead of 48px. With the source ledger ending at x680, begin the brief column at x704 rather than x728. Preserve the source ratio and existing ledger width; do not add decorative notches, shadows or a replacement media container.
drift.why: The approved Lab separates its source and working plane by 24px. Production uses a generic 48px column separation, weakening the defining source-to-decision relationship.
drift.where: Boundary between the left reference/ledger assembly and the campaign-brief column.

drift.change: Expose an ink-labelled Open reference button beside or beneath Your reference, with a minimum 44px target height. Connect it to the original uploaded asset or its existing inspector. If the image already opens inspection, retain that behavior and make the action visibly discoverable.
drift.why: The 240px-wide preview has only a caption and source-type ledger entry. No visible control explains how to inspect details while writing the brief; the Lab explicitly exposes Open original.
drift.where: Reference image and caption at the left of the flow.

drift.change: Increase the requirement suggestion buttons from approximately 36px to at least 44px high. Give each requirement removal control a 44×44px hit area and make its chip at least 44px high. Retain 8px gaps and the existing restrained control treatment.
drift.why: Both suggestion buttons and the removable requirement chips are visibly shorter than the approved 44px minimum target. The small × controls make removal especially imprecise.
drift.where: Must include: selected requirement chips and the two suggested additions.

review.why: Most of the visual language transferred convincingly: the shell, neutral surfaces, typography hierarchy, source ratio and primary-action emphasis align with the approved system. Real draft data remains editable, the source stays beside the task, and no invented analysis or financial state appears. The remaining gaps are concrete rather than a need for redesign: a 48px instead of 24px source/brief separation, no visible original-reference inspection action, and approximately 36px requirement controls. Nothing in the capture demonstrates a broken core form action, but a still image cannot prove those actions execute correctly.
review.verdict: The shell and brief workflow transferred well, but Frame Shift needs its 24px joint, discoverable reference inspection and compliant control targets before desktop release.
